name: wallet-interactive-cardholder-wallet
title: Wallet — Interactive Cardholder Wallet
description: Hover over the wallet to smoothly slide out the 3 cards serially. Click any card to pull it high out of the wallet, then click it again to 3D-flip and reveal its back face (magnetic stripe, signature box & CVV). Moving the cursor away resets all cards back inside.
